technical_and_design_decisions: For U1 and U2: Extract existing @Rule test fixtures into separate repositories, maintaining backward compatibility via transitive dependencies.
For U3: Implement a platform abstraction layer (adapter pattern) for Lattice, YARN, and Cloud Foundry to ensure consistent REST API exposure.
For U4: Extend the artifact registration system to support 'library' type artifacts, modifying include/exclude logic to reference these artifacts.
For U5: Introduce a 'named channel' concept in the stream DSL, allowing pipelines without explicit source/sink modules, and update deployment logic accordingly.
For U6: Develop additional unit and integration tests for StreamController endpoints using Spring MVC Test and mocked dependencies.
For U7: Add stream name uniqueness validation at the service layer and API level, returning appropriate error messages.
For U8: Integrate the Kinesis binder as a source module, reusing existing binder patterns from Spring Cloud Stream.
assumptions: The development team is experienced with Spring Framework, Spring Cloud Data Flow, and Spring Cloud Stream codebases.
All changes will be implemented in Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Existing build and CI pipeline (Maven/Gradle) can be reused for new modules and repos.
No additional infrastructure setup beyond standard development environment is needed.
Effort estimates are for implementation only, not including code review, documentation, or deployment.

activities.activity_name: Admin REST API consistency across platforms
activities.activity_description: Design and implement platform abstraction for Lattice, YARN, and Cloud Foundry to expose consistent REST APIs for admin operations. Includes adapters and endpoint modifications.
Extend artifact registration to support library type artifacts. Update include/exclude logic and corresponding API/UI.
Implement named channel support in the stream DSL parser and deployment logic, allowing pipelines without source or sink modules.
Write unit and integration tests for StreamController endpoints to verify API contracts at build time.
Add validation logic to detect and reject duplicate stream names during creation, with appropriate error responses.
Integrate Kinesis binder as a source module for Spring Cloud Stream, including configuration and tests.
